tool.name: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management
aliases: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management for AI
tool.description: Purview posture tool that discovers AI apps and agents, flags oversharing and risky prompts, and applies DLP to AI use.
strengths: AI observability for Copilot and agents
One-click DLP policies for AI prompts
tool.statusNote: The standalone DSPM for AI experience is now labelled "classic" and replaced by the unified DSPM, which receives new features (Microsoft Learn, checked 2026-09-30).
tool.practitionerNote: Strongest where Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and Foundry agents dominate; third-party AI sites need the Purview browser extension and device onboarding. Full capability requires Microsoft 365 E5 or Purview Suite licensing, and some options use pay-as-you-go billing.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Follows Microsoft 365 data location commitments (customer data kept in chosen geography); no customer-hosted option.

deployment.detail: Microsoft-managed SaaS within the Microsoft Purview portal.

auditLogging.detail: AI prompts/responses and agent interactions captured in the Purview unified audit log and activity explorer.

soc2.detail: Office 365 SOC 2 Type 2 covers Compliance Manager (commercial) and the Purview portal in GCC/GCC High/DoD; DSPM not named separately.

iso27001.detail: Microsoft Purview portal is listed in the Office 365 ISO 27001 in-scope services (commercial and government).

iso42001.detail: Microsoft's ISO 42001 in-scope list covers Copilot, Copilot Studio, Foundry and Security Copilot, not Purview.

euAiAct.detail: Data security/compliance tooling, not itself a high-risk AI system; its Compliance Manager templates help map AI regulations.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Microsoft SaaS tied to Microsoft 365 E5/Purview Suite licensing; no OSS path.
